oracle.method: For each size compare Summary::render() against real native core fold over all generated Acts after maintenance timing. Require identical rendered output across all sizes and binary snapshot roundtrip equality.
oracle.inputs: Actual generated native Message/Act objects, 8 keys with repeated explicit replacements, fixed output value, increasing nonce and canonical HLC. 24 live contributions represent 8 keys in each of 3 rule shelves.
oracle.coverage: Exact BTreeSet lookup over previously accepted wire identities; no cryptographic proof verification or admission/signature authentication in this scaling test.
oracle.archive: No archive interface or body fetches in the test maintenance path; do not interpret this as an instrumented end-to-end host archive-read measurement.

encoding_contract.header: u32 version=1, schema h32, u32 row count
encoding_contract.live_row: vec<(wire identity bytes, authenticated signer bytes, normalized native Message bytes)>; ascending identities; every decoded identity checked against reconstructed Act
encoding_contract.pending_row: Ordered encoded (canonical native scope bytes, wire target bytes) pairs
encoding_contract.normalization: Erase native signed signature slot only; canonicalize recipient None/One/Set by cardinality and Core/Custom performative-name aliases; retain semantic wrappers, parameter order and causal order. Original signed evidence remains outside summary.
encoding_contract.profile_gate: Summary::expected_profile_hash(expected_clause) must equal independently pinned context.profile; unknown profiles unsupported.
encoding_contract.draft_snapshot_compatibility: Earlier draft rows without explicit wire identities require regeneration.
